The next thing I knew the Dr sent me for a trans vaginal ultrasound. I asked why and was given one of those precautionary answers - oh, nothing really, we just need a better look. Unfortunately I wasn’t the woman I am today and I didn’t push back for more info, as I would now. So what is a TVU? They basically take an ultrasound wand the size of a cucumber, put a condom on it, add some lube, and get it on in there. It HURT. I was not given permission to see the results. Then the office called and wanted me to do another one. I asked why and was given another just to be safe bs answer. I went the second time. Same sitch. Same pain. No report back from the dr. At all. So I called. Oh everything is fine. THIS WAS SO unethical I can’t even. I should have filed a complaint with the state licensing board, and wouldn’t hesitate today. But I wasn’t that woman then. I held onto the evening is fine answer, with relief - but then never went back there. It was years later that I put the research pieces together. She retired eventually. Then she died. Yeah, I kept looking her up. It was traumatic as F. NEVER allow procedures or tests without knowing EXACTLY why and NEVER accept not seeing results. She was an evil Dr. Truly evil.
